title: Bump package.json too
brief: npm publishes the version in package.json, which drifted from VERSION twice. bump-version.sh updates both. Releases are cut from the maintainers' Macs and from Linux CI.

expected.why: `sed -i "s/…/"` is GNU-only: BSD sed on macOS takes the script as the backup suffix and fails (set -e aborts after VERSION was already written), so a release cut on a Mac leaves the two versions out of step.
